title: Alpha One — event kyc.submitted v1
description: V1 catalog event `kyc.submitted` (v1). Envelope per EVT-03 (see envelope.schema.json). Producer/consumers per contracts/events/catalog.md: consumers = ANA-01 (no V1 email — D61: pre-decision record). Derived from: docs/13 §4.1 (V1 kyc.* events) + docs/32 `kyc_sessions` (id, provider, provider_case_id, identity_id). Money is integer minor units (docs/00 #3); the envelope carries tenant_id — no redundant tenant field in the payload.

kyc_session_id.description: kyc_sessions.id (the API path parameter is still named kyc_verification_id — docs/13 §7.1; same id)
